تغتفرين (form VIII)
# تَغْتَفِرِينَ (taḡtafirīna) /taɣ.ta.fi.riː.na/: second-person feminine singular non-past active indicative of اِغْتَفَرَ (iḡtafara)
# تُغْتَفَرِينَ (tuḡtafarīna) /tuɣ.ta.fa.riː.na/: second-person feminine singular non-past passive indicative of اِغْتَفَرَ (iḡtafara)
